changes_made.explanation: Added 'Semantic Parsing' as the main task. Simplified outputs to focus on core generated content. The paper primarily generates meaning representations and canonical utterances, with paraphrase generation being a supporting component.
Simplified metrics to base form. 'top-1 accuracy' and 'top-20 accuracy' are variants of Accuracy metric, so kept only 'Accuracy' as the base metric.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The models mentioned (T5, PEGASUS, MPNet) are used for generation and retrieval, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. Evaluation was done entirely through automatic metrics (accuracy).

overall_notes: This paper focuses on zero-shot semantic parsing using a retrieval-based framework with self-training. The main NLG task is semantic parsing (generating meaning representations), with paraphrase generation as a supporting component. Evaluation is done purely through accuracy metrics without human or LLM-based evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed refinement on task categorization and metric normalization.
